params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: hide_empty
params.description: Whether to hide terms not assigned to any posts.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: lang
params.description: Limit results to a specific language. By default, results are not filtered by language.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit result set to terms assigned to a specific parent.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

params.name: post
params.description: Limit result set to terms assigned to a specific post.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to terms with one or more specific slugs.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated collection of taxonomy from www.exentis-group.com. No authentication required. Pagination totals are returned in the X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages response headers.

info.name: Retrieve a single taxonomy by id

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier for the object.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. `edit` requires authentication.

items.docs: Retrieve one object by its numeric WordPress id. No authentication required.
